    &middot; &ldquo;Technical anti-patterns happen in code. Organizational anti-patterns amplify every technical failure&rdquo;
  </div>

  <div class="ws-instruction">
    Fill this page alone and in silence, before you see anyone else's. You need no data, no repository
    and no telemetry &mdash; only honesty. For each of the five organisational anti-patterns, mark it
    Present, Emerging or Absent using the key below, cite the occurrence that justifies the mark, name
    the technical anti-pattern it amplifies, then write the organisational action and the person who
    owns it. Sign the page. Only then turn it face up and compare; where you and a colleague marked the
    same row differently, record both marks at the foot. Do not average and do not fill as a group.
  </div>

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>Rubric key <span class="ws-block-note">authored for this sheet &mdash; the chapter supplies no scale</span></h2>
    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup><col style="width:14%"><col style="width:86%"></colgroup>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td class="prior"><b>Present</b></td>
          <td class="prior">We can name at least one occurrence in the last quarter, and no control exists that would stop it recurring.<span class="prior-src">derived &mdash; authored for this sheet</span></td></tr>
        <tr><td class="prior"><b>Emerging</b></td>
          <td class="prior">We can name an occurrence, but a control exists or is being built.<span class="prior-src">derived &mdash; authored for this sheet</span></td></tr>
        <tr><td class="prior"><b>Absent</b></td>
          <td class="prior">We cannot name an occurrence, and a control exists that would have caught one.<span class="prior-src">derived &mdash; authored for this sheet</span></td></tr>
        <tr><td class="locked" colspan="2">Note: &ldquo;we cannot name an occurrence&rdquo; with no control in place is <b>Present</b>, not Absent &mdash; an unobserved failure in an unmonitored area is the definition of this chapter's subject. A row you cannot place against the key is Present. &ldquo;Partly&rdquo;, &ldquo;improving&rdquo; and &ldquo;n/a&rdquo; are not marks.</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

          <td class="prior">Ships agent-generated code with minimal review, and agent code fails differently &mdash; locally correct, globally inconsistent.<span class="prior-src">ch20 L363</span></td>

        <tr>

          <td class="prior">No primitives; each developer prompts ad hoc. Output quality varies by context, not skill, and the team blames the tool.<span class="prior-src">ch20 L365</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">Present</span><span class="opt">Emerging</span><span class="opt">Absent</span></div></td>

        </tr>

          <td class="prior"><b>No feedback loop</b><span class="prior-src">ch20 L367</span></td>

          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">Present</span><span class="opt">Emerging</span><span class="opt">Absent</span></div></td>

          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">incident</span><span class="opt">review record</span><span class="opt">cost record</span><span class="opt">recollection</span></div></td>

          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">Present</span><span class="opt">Emerging</span><span class="opt">Absent</span></div></td>

          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">incident</span><span class="opt">review record</span><span class="opt">cost record</span><span class="opt">recollection</span></div></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="prior"><b>Abandoned governance</b><span class="prior-src">ch20 L371</span></td>
          <td class="prior">Nobody audits what agents modify outside stated scope; nobody tracks token cost against value.<span class="prior-src">ch20 L371</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">Present</span><span class="opt">Emerging</span><span class="opt">Absent</span></div></td>

          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">incident</span><span class="opt">review record</span><span class="opt">cost record</span><span class="opt">recollection</span></div></td>
